reviews.title: My first medal!
reviews.text: This was so fun and super encouraging! Thank you so much! On to the next challenge ☺️

reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text: Do not use this app- better off walking without it. I got it thinking it was a monthly subscription app and the challenges were a monthly thing. No you have to BUY EACH challenge (like the harry potter one is over $200). Anyone smart would not pay that and would not use the app because of the price.

reviews.title: Shady
reviews.text: Just know that if you sign up for a 5 event digital race for $30, you are only getting access to one of the 5 stops. You are signing up to have access to a glorified fitness tracker for 2-3 months for $30. At best their advertising and their app is vague and confusing about this. At worst, it's intentionally misleading.

reviews.title: Money Grab with a Cool Underdeveloped Idea
reviews.text: The app itself is just a store. Forget finding your challenge progress or reading any of the actual challenge content. This app 100% just prompts you to buy more races and does not give a good experience to people who have purchased a race.

reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Mi experiencia con The Conqueror ha sido excelente. Es mucho más que una aplicación para registrar millas o kilómetros; convierte cada recorrido en una meta y hace que mantenerse activo sea mucho más entretenido y motivador.

Me encanta poder completar desafíos, ver mi progreso y sentir que cada milla recorrida me acerca a un nuevo objetivo. Además, las medallas son de excelente calidad y se convierten en un bonito recuerdo de cada logro alcanzado.

Se nota el esfuerzo y la dedicación que el equipo de The Conqueror ha puesto en desarrollar y mejorar la aplicación. La recomiendo a cualquier persona que quiera mantenerse activa, establecer nuevas metas y disfrutar del proceso mientras las alcanza.

¡Excelente trabajo y que sigan mejorando! Definitivamente seguiré conquistando nuevos desafíos. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.title: Super Motivation!
reviews.text: I wanted to take a minute and review this app after using it for years. The app itself is stable and reliable and I have taken for granted how easy and convenient it is to stay in contact with my friends and family on our 'walks.' The pictures and postcards are fun and it is quite motivational to have this tracking my steps throughout the year. I also have a lovely collection of medals to remember the various finished courses. If you are trying to get more active or to find a non-social media way to connect to friends over a distance, I highly recommend this app. It is also wonderful contributing (even in a small way) towards cleaning up plastic from the oceans and planting trees.

reviews.title: A fun way to get in your miles
reviews.text: I’ve enjoyed picking challenges and watching my progress throughout. It was a fun way to increase my weekly mileage.

reviews.title: Pay them for you to exercise?
reviews.text: First, I guess it's a nice gimmick, receiving a metal medal which is mass produced and sent to you after you complete a challenge. OK, it's a nice feat and a nice prize. However, these medals are made in and shipped from China. You're paying anywhere from 30-60 dollars for something that most likely cost a few dollars to make in China. Then you have to wait almost a month for the medal to get to you. I really feel cheated here. Pay in advance, do the walking or running or whatever exercise you do, feel good about yourself, forget all about the chunk of metal until it arrives a month later, feel cheated because of the reality you paid 50 dollars for something that cost a couple dollars to make, and they used the slowest shipping method available to send it to you as it takes a month. When I sent stuff from Thailand to the States it took about a week. A month is just crazy. Oh well. I did two challenges and I think I'm done. It's just not worth it to me. I exercise anyways so at least I win. If I want a piece of metal for my efforts I can make one cheaper than this outfits sells.

reviews.title: Nice but, a matter of settings
reviews.text: Should be more “intelligent” in connecting and reading from other apps, as it duplicates readings. 🤷🏻

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
Down side:

I have found Google Maps satellite more satisfying to navigate than the paths shown in these challenges. And Middle-earth offered not a single image or nod to anything Middle-earth.
Buying the bundles has been extremely confusing.

It would be nice ahead of time to know the route so that I can go back and revisit them at a later time (and maybe even visit in real life…)

Upside: I sure hope the medals are worth the $40+ dollars I spent, and the one thing that keeps me motivated is knowing trees are being planted.

reviews.title: Wonderful Application
reviews.text: The Conqueror Challenges and application have been wonderful! I have been continually utilizing for two years now! The application worked wonderful for a team building challenge I did for my staff. Everyone uses different operating systems and devices to track the progress and it was an outstanding simplified experience for everyone! From tracking challenge progress with almost any device, to seeing other team members progress and challenges they were working on, and cheering each other on!!

reviews.title: Very happy with my experience!
reviews.text: I’m loving The Conqueror! It keeps me motivated to walk more, and I’m completely hooked on unlocking the history and learning something new with every mile. It makes walking so much more fun! I haven’t received my metal yet. I completed it yesterday today they told me it was on its way. Onto the next challenge!!

reviews.title: Motivating
reviews.text: Enjoying the app and the challenges.  Doing them as a team gives you fun time to spend completing the challenges.

reviews.title: So much fun, and app is easy to use
reviews.text: We’ve been doing conquerer challenges for a long time, and the app keeps getting better. It’s now very easy to start, log, and complete challenges and get medals. The challenges are fun and the medals are so over the top, we have a blast unpacking them every time.

reviews.title: Love the walk, hate the interface.
reviews.text:
It’s a great app, great company, and I love all that it’s brought to my health. 

That being said, the UI is kinda all over the place. I wish it was more user friendly. 

Also user beware, when purchasing walks, it will offer you a deal, that deal is in addition to. Not including. It seems kinda deceptive given how many people are caught off guard by that. 

All that said, great program, does wonders for your health. But the app can use some work.

reviews.title: A nice reward that keeps you moving
reviews.text: I’ve enjoyed using this app to keep me motivated to move. I know you still “pay” for it, but that’s a small price that I am very willing to pay, especially when you get to pick the medals you think are the coolest (and they have tons of cool medals to choose from). I’d like to see some more collaboration with movie/TV/game series but all in all this platform has been awesome to use and I’ll continue using it

reviews.title: Farm you your data from orders and spam
reviews.text: Know two things, first this is a Chinese based company setting up satellite offices to disguise their activities. If you’re in the USA they use GoFo a Chinese based delivery company run by a Chinese ceo. Second, they will steal your phone number after placing the order for your award and start texting you. Typical CCP operation.

reviews.title: Motivation Starts Here
reviews.text: Highly recommended if you need that extra daily push to meet fitness goals. New races are available every two weeks (or less) and the app provides all you need re: recording movement data, changing race distances to fit your needs, etc. Conqueror Challenges also have an excellent help center.

reviews.title: I’m Walking!
reviews.text: I’m 67 and I’m getting back in shape! All I have to do is walk. If I’m out shopping, in the yard or cleaning the house, I’m moving and slowly adding steps. I can set the time I think it will take me. That’s a big plus.

reviews.title: Family adventures
reviews.text: My 3.5 year old son have been signing up for walking challenges for the last two summers to track our steps during our summer adventures. We have completed 5 challenges so far these past two years and just signed up for a 6ths one for our fall/halloween adventures. He gets so excited when his wanted medal comes in the mail.

reviews.title: Helps motivate me to be more active!
reviews.text: Simple as that. I’m being more active since starting conqueror challenges. At bare minimum I’m really working to make sure o get in those 10k steps a day!

reviews.title: Helped me love exercise!
reviews.text: When I started my first challenge, I doubted it could motivate me to exercise and I thought my interest would fade. I was so very wrong! I love the challenges - I’m on my sixth - and they’ve given me a love for movement. The app is so much fun. Try it!

reviews.title: Motivating and Rewarding
reviews.text: This app and the challenges make fitness fun! I just finished the Lord of the Rings Shire to Mordor challenge and it made me excited to get my steps in. The app interface is great, the stories and postcards are exciting, and the medals are topnotch. It's also a great marker to your days and travels and turns everyday walks to an event. I really enjoy it and highly recommend to others :) there is something in there for you.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: I tried several of the popular apps at the same time and Conqueror was the best platform in my opinion. Very clean and easy to navigate.

reviews.title: Healing
reviews.text:
For a year and a half I have been struggling with depression. I lost a very close friend unexpectedly. I have been grieving him for a long time now. 

I used to be so athletic, always on the go. I was on Facebook and I saw a video of a Scooby-Doo medal. I used to love watching the cartoon show. I saw that this was an offer that might be able motivate me to get active again. 

I decided to give it a go. This was my first challenge. 50 miles, I told myself you can do this. I used to walk 7-10 miles about 5 days a week before the depression. Well, I finished Scooby-Doo in 2 weeks. I am very proud of myself. 

Today, I started my 2nd one Looney Tunes, Bugs Bunny. 

This is my healing journey. This is the start to the new stronger and healthier ME!!

reviews.title: Won’t help
reviews.text: I completed a challenge. My toddler pushed the button before I got to confirm my address and nobody is helping me. I don’t recommend this app. They’re just gonna take your money. I think it’s a scam because I’ve been waiting for 40 minutes for customer service on Arnaldo who won’t reply

reviews.title: Josh Jones
reviews.text: This is a great app

reviews.title: Love This App!
reviews.text: I’ve done the Shire to Mordor Challenge and can’t believe the quality of the medals. The app is wonderfully interactive. I’m always highly motivated to track my progress!

reviews.title: Please let me purchase challenges directly in the app.
reviews.text: I’m begging you to make the process of purchasing a challenge more seamless. The website gives me so many issues whenever it’s time for a new challenge.

reviews.title: Micro transaction city
reviews.text: $30 per challenge is insane

reviews.title: User Friendly
reviews.text: The app is very user friendly and simple to use! I am not a very savvy app person, but I am glad I actually can use the app pretty easily. Also the feature on the actual challenge are great!

reviews.title: Simpler UI
reviews.text: We are really enjoying our challenges.  Something we like is “buy 2, get one free”.  An area of improvement would be the User Interface UI.  I want my Home Screen to show just my current challenges.  Overall navigation menus, options, ect. Could also be made more user friendly.

reviews.title: Amazing app!
reviews.text: I’m exercising more! It’s great to have a reward once you accomplish your challenge!

reviews.title: Broken
reviews.text: That refuses to open for me and keeps freezing and crashing right after it’s clicked

reviews.title: So much fun
reviews.text: If you love a challenge and a motivating community this is the app for you. The challenges are fun and interactive. I love all of the history and facts you can learn along the way. I’m on my 8th challenge and seriously addicted. It has helped me stick to my workouts and make new friends. The medals are so cool and thoughtful. If you’re stuck between joining or not just do it you won’t regret it.

reviews.title: Get to steppin’
reviews.text: Love this program. Helps me get my steps in and makes it feel so much more worthwhile

reviews.title: Found me when I needed it most
reviews.text: I had just lost my oldest son at 24 and was grieving and isolated during Covid. I saw an ad for Conqueror challenges and it was the first time in almost 2 years I felt like trying anything remotely healthy. I’m now on my 8th challenge. All I can say is that this motivated me and gave me something to look forward to when nothing else did. The self pace and ability to add different types of activities were so helpful to me. I know my son would want me to take care of myself. And I know he would love all the cool medals, just like I loved all his when he was doing sports. Thank you Conqueror. No app is perfect, but you’ve put a lot of thought into this one and it shows.

reviews.title: 5 star fitness
reviews.text: I love this app, it has so many amazing ways to get you up and active. You can choose your pace and adjust if you didn’t make your goal. The challenges are based off cities but as well as different movies that you know and love. The medals are top quality as well.  I definitely recommend this to anyone whether you’re walking or running it’s a great way to get active.

reviews.title: Changed my life
reviews.text: Always thought these challenges were a scam until I tried it.  I'm hooked now.  It's crazy how you see the world walking different by walking or running.  This motivates me to walk a little further and has helped me with weight loss.  Try it out, so many different challenges you can try.  I love the community and the app which is easy to use.  Overall, 5 stars.

reviews.title: It’s Worth it!
reviews.text: These challenges have helped me meet my weight loss goal and made cardio for for me! Also for the price you are not getting some cheap medal! Sign up and conquer your fears!

reviews.title: The Start of A Fun Workout
reviews.text: So I’ve started this about  a week ago. Since then I’ve completed 2 medals and am now working on the 3rd. This is a fun motivation app, a great reward, you do t have to get a physical medal if you don’t want, you decide if you want your milestones to plant trees or help clean up plastic. This is a great app and I recommend it to anyone who is interested in getting healthy and goal oriented

reviews.title: Step counts
reviews.text: It drives me absolutely nuts that the app doesn’t sync every step from Apple Health. I’ve had the app for a year now and it only ever logs about half of the steps and it’s not worth the price to have to enter things manually. It’s 2026 and these things should be automatic.

reviews.title: Shipping
reviews.text: The app is great! Love reading about the local area on the virtual rides and walks. I’ve done more walking and bike riding since starting these challenges. Only problem is the shipping. I wish there were options on which carrier I could choose from. My medal has been stuck in a transit facility, 30 miles from my house for 6 days.

reviews.title: So much fun
reviews.text: It is great and I loved it because just by walking I can win medals and can compete with friends or family.

reviews.title: Motivating
reviews.text: It definitely working to get me to work out. Can’t wait for my first medal I just earned.

reviews.title: Fan But Not Happy With Pin Process
reviews.text: I overall like the app and will continue to use, but I’m not a fan of how they are implementing the new Pins. If you’ve been loyal to Conqueror (which also means spending lots of money) you’d have earned several Levels of Pins. However, they only allow you to actually get the most recent level with your next medal. If you want the previous pins, you have to spend $2 a pin or feel your collection is incomplete. This feels like a small slap in the face to those who have been loyal and consistent users of the app.

reviews.title: Great - One Sneaky Catch
reviews.text: I love the challenges and they keep me motivated to hit my daily step count while trying to lose unwanted fat. The SNEAKY catch, was that I was advertised a 3 challenge bundle, which I was planning to use to finish the LOTR challenges, only to find out the 3 challenge bundle does not apply to certain specialized challenges.  I was pretty disappointed, but I’ve still utilized my three basic challenges accordingly. I’ll just have to wait on the rest of the LOTR ones. Only 4 stars instead of 5 because of the sneaky advertisement.

reviews.title: Kind of pointless
reviews.text:
This is a great concept, but an obvious cash grab from nerds who are all to happy to throw their money away on pointless, landfill-bound trinkets. I don't care about the "medals," no way I'm paying for that (I'm an adult, don't need a sticker when I do a good job). But I did think this would be a fun way of keeping myself on track for fitness goals, and you can buy access to a map for a more reasonable price. 

Unfortunately the execution is seriously lacking. You aren't shown on your route in real time; the app syncs with Apple Health 1x per day and appears to struggle to do that correctly (my distance was doubled on my first day, which is not what I'm after). The map doesn't really show anything interesting and overall the app lacks in features and interactivity in the way I was hoping it would.

Beyond that the interface is poor, seems deliberately confusing in order to grab more cash. Not recommended.

reviews.title: The App doesn’t track accurate
reviews.text: I did 6 challenges so far and after the second one app stopped working for me. Since I purchased them all together. I DO NOT RECOMMEND!!! It wasn’t syncing with my watch and there was a hidden built in app called the conqueror steps that one don’t use that one, makes your phone drain battery fast and inaccurate data the steps doesn’t show at all if your phone dies. I contacted their customer service and they absolutely treated me like I’m the dumbest person ever. And still not helped. I feel scammed and worse than when I started so I hope you won’t need their app support and everything works for you. But do not commit to doing more than once at a time they will make sure you regret that and you will get an email how stupid you were for not being able to  use the app.
This app is such a joy. The medals and the maps make me smile. Hoping to complete another challenge soon. 😙
